items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Then they'd together and come out here and visit me. But Professor Patton passed about three years ago, so I haven't seen him since.

ctx.x: -- Professor Patton. And he hung around with Professor Patton when he'd come to town, and he'd stay two to three days with him. Then they'd together and come out here and visit me. But Professor Patton passed about three years ago, so I haven't seen him since. But he was down there running the (?), something around there called Red something, man, where he had a big club. And Don Albert ran that club for him for years and years down there. They called it Red Something -- I forget its last name.
Now, if you can remember back that far, this little band from New Orleans that you played with...
